newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's NSW offers bed tax rebate for bookings.
newsitem.headline: Australia's NSW offers bed tax rebate for bookings.

text.p: Sydney hotels with forward bookings until end-March next year will have a recently announced 10 percent bed tax refunded by the New South Wales (NSW) state government, Treasurer Michael Egan said on Tuesday.

Egan met representatives of the the Australian Hotels Association (AHA) on Tuesday and agreed to offer a rebate on the tax for city hotels which can prove they cannot pass on the 10 percent impost, he told reporters.
Egan said there was already A$99 million worth of hotel accommodation package deals secured from September this year until March 31, 1998.
The A$10 million rebate will be paid directly to hotels which have already received payment for package deals to that date, Egan said.
The AHA has bitterly opposed the bed tax, announced in the recent state budget, which it says has already led to a loss of tourist bookings.
The bed tax applies only to hotels in inner and North Sydney.
